comparison.objective: Start a hex nut on a stud without cross-threading and run it down by hand.
comparison.physical_skill: Thread engagement using reverse-turn drop detection followed by forward threading.
comparison.success_condition: Title specifies correct thread start and run-down; the indexed record has no numeric scoring rubric.
comparison.reason: Thread-start quality is different from counterholding an already engaged adjustment screw while tightening its jam nut and preserving calibration.
